findings.problem: 召回 is the only occurrence of 召回 in the zh-CN catalogue; EN's recall reads 移回 in five shipped places, including the control this chip opens. Naming the action with a word the control never uses costs the reader a translation step. Pre-existing (it predates wave B and the earlier audit listed it under verified-no-finding); this wave made it the sole outlier by fixing row.not_here_why.

Not a shipping blocker; a one-line, wider-by-4-cells fix in a file this wave already touches.

resolutions.earlier_suggestion: 登录信息仍已保存。稍后重试，或选择其他模型。
resolutions.applied: 登录信息仍已保存。稍后重试，或选择其他模型。
resolutions.judgement: Applied verbatim, and it is an improvement rather than a preference: it removes the 'saved … still retained' duplication (已保存的登录信息仍然保留) and reproduces the sentence the locale already ships for the same English fact (ui.settings.integrations.integration_model.the_sign_in_is_still_saved = 登录信息仍已保存。), so the two surfaces now agree word for word. 仍已保存 is formal but established in this catalogue; it asserts the credential is still stored and never implies loss or expiry, which is what the sidecar forbids. The remedy clause keeps the catalogue's 稍后重试 / 选择其他模型 pair.
resolutions.checked: grep '仍已保存' -> ui.settings.integrations (shipped) + this key; both now identical in the first sentence.

resolutions.decision: resolved, with a deviation the auditor accepts
resolutions.judgement: The finding's substance was that 事项 is bound to to-dos in this file (ui.chat.run_details.todos.title = 待办事项), so the line could be heard as a narrower claim than 'Nothing in flight'. 活动 removes that binding and 待办事项 keeps its own word, so the finding is answered. The deviation is accepted on evidence: (a) 进行中 is the catalogue's in-flight term (ui.projects.project_board.in_flight = 进行中, ui.projects.project_model.active = 进行中, ui.common.updates.update_foot_icon.in_progress = {subject}进行中{percent}。); (b) 暂无 opens the file's other empty line (nothing_to_show_yet = 暂无可显示的内容。), so the panel speaks one dialect; (c) it is 18 cells against EN 18, where the proposal was 20. Counter-argument weighed and rejected: 暂无 carries a 'for now' colour that 'Nothing in flight.' does not, and the sibling arm uses 暂无 for EN's explicit 'yet' — but the two lines are the two arms of one return and never draw together (run-details-panel.tsx draws exactly one), and 暂无 is the standard Chinese empty-state opener rather than a prediction. No action required.
resolutions.checked: call site run-details-panel.tsx:437-440 (hasRunDetails ? nothing_to_show_yet : nothing_in_flight); width 18 vs 18.

resolutions.earlier_suggestion: 此会话运行{label}，但登录不可用，因此在连接之前无法作答。
resolutions.applied: 此会话运行{label}，但登录不可用，因此在连接之前无法作答。
resolutions.judgement: Applied verbatim. 登录不可用 names the state the catalogue already has words for (未登录{label}, 登录信息) instead of turning 'a working sign-in' into an object (可用的登录), and it still does not blame an expired credential, which the sidecar reserves for the sibling arm. {label} stays verbatim and unspaced from the CJK run, as the guide requires; the objectless 在连接之前 is right here because the remedy is the band's own connect control.

resolutions.applied: 本机已离线。发送将排队等待。 / 无法连接Local Operator服务器。发送将排队等待。
resolutions.judgement: Applied to both keys. 排队等待 was the group's one calque (发送将等待); the strip now uses the locale's queued verb, and the 将/已 pair (发送将排队等待 vs 消息已排队等待 in degraded) keeps EN's own distinction between 'Sending will wait' and 'Your messages are queued' while the queue itself is named the same way in both rows. Weighed and not filed: the zh is one step more concrete than EN's bare 'wait', but the promise is the same one EN makes (the send waits, it is not lost), and the two rows that say it are the two where nothing can be delivered yet. The subjects stay correct — 本机 for 'this machine' (shipped: 本机：…, 本机的…), Local Operator untouched and unspaced per the guide.
resolutions.checked: degraded sibling 消息已排队等待; state vocabulary read in chat-status.ts (internet-offline vs degraded are distinct root causes).

findings_note: The receipt-wide findings list is intentionally empty: this audit's only defect is recorded in the ui.chat.device namespace block (ZH-WBD-1), which is where the ledger's severity counts are read from. Resolved earlier findings are in `resolutions`, not counted again.
observations_not_findings: ui.chat.device.sentence.gone / gone_did_not_answer render the recall as 带回此处 where the rest of the locale says 移回. EN itself says 'bring it back here' there and 'recall it here' in row.not_here_why, so 带回 is a faithful rendering of a different English verb; not filed. If the locale later standardises one verb for the action regardless of English verb, 带回此处 is the second candidate.
ui.chat.device.sentence.local's 召回 is the only 召回 in the catalogue and is filed as ZH-WBD-1; it predates this wave.

发送将排队等待 makes EN's bare 'Sending will wait' one step more concrete by naming the queue. Weighed as an observation, not a finding: the promise is EN's own (the send waits, nothing is lost), the queue is how this app words the same state in the sibling degraded row, and the strip's two rows never draw together.
The strip draws one title plus main's own detail line (chat-status.ts), so no other copy in that surface can contradict these values.
Width holds on this head: the widest wave-B value is pairing_guidance at 94 cells against EN 112, and no value but tool_row.generic_verb.running is wider than its English (accepted, +1 cell).
limitations: No browser or rendered frame was available, so no pixel, truncation or overflow claim is made; widths are codepoint cell counts, not measurements.

The English copy was read as the source, not audited as English; the one English change (the closed code span) was verified only for what it does to both locales through the formatter.
